ValidationRule.description: A running plan with a completed date, or a finished plan without one, makes the list views lie about what is still open.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Running"), NOT(ISBLANK(Completed_Date__c)) ), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Running")), ISBLANK(Completed_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A running plan has no completed date, and a complete or cancelled plan needs one.
